name: "repo-skill-installer"
description: "Use when the user asks to install a Skill from a GitHub repository."
---

Install the requested repository by running the bundled helper through exec_command.
Use skill.entry `scripts/install.py`, skill.workdir `.`, buffered mode, network enabled,
and read_write access. Pass the user-provided repository and path unchanged as
`python scripts/install.py --repo A1m233/maa-daily-skill --path maa-daily`.
The destination is the host-resolved `personal_skills` standard locator; request it as
an additional read_write root. Do not use or guess an installation absolute path.

</skill>
